name: Mea to Rougoku no Heya
source:
Yuta, the main character, has a childhood friend named Tomo.

He was having a good school life with my his friend, Mea.

One day, two beautiful girls fight each other over Yuta.

This is a sweet and sad Yandere story with a love triangle.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6280]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
主人公Yuta有一位名叫Tomo的青梅竹马。

他与好友梅亚一起，过着愉快的校园生活。

某天，两名美少女为了争夺Yuta而针锋相对。

这是一个围绕三角恋展开，甜蜜又悲伤的病娇故事。

[译自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6280]NovelGame[/url]]
